content.title: Fury vs Makhmudov LIVE: Benn vs Prograis, fight updates, news and results as Tyson Fury fights Arslanbek Makhmudov at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium
content.text: Fury vs Makhmudov as it happenedMain card at Tottenham Hotspur StadiumTyson Fury beats Arslanbek Makhmudov by unanimous decision View postFury immediately challenges Joshua to fight him nextJoshua watches from ringside and replies 'you don't tell me what to do'AJ later says they will 'probably' fight next once terms are agreedConor Benn dominates Regis Prograis in victory View postRichard Riakporhe stops Jeamie TKV in Round 5 View postJustis Huni beat Frazer Clarke by majority decision View postFury will fight AJ this year in 'boxing's World Cup final' Fury to AJ: let's fight next!Live updates from Cam Hogwood, with John Dennen at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium Fury beats Makhmudov on return to boxingTyson Fury returned to boxing to beat Arslanbek Makmudov at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in London.He secured a wide unanimous decision over Makhmudov, with Anthony Joshua, his great rival, watching intently from ringside.Sky Sports' John Dennen reports from Tottenham...Until next time!Will they? Won't they? At one stage tonight we felt as if we were about to get the fight announcement for which we have waited so long. Apparently not. In the end, there remain more questions over when we will see Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua in the ring, if ever. It was a successful comeback fight for the Gypsy King as he made light work of Arslanbek Makhmudov in his first fight since his rematch defeat to Oleksandr Usyk in December 2024. Conor Benn meanwhile beat Regis Prograis to tee up a potential Ryan Garcia clash - we will see. That's all from us tonight, but we'll be back soon as the boxing continues! Garcia next for Benn?Conor Benn speaking to Netflix..."Prograis presented different challenges to Eubank, Eubank is a great fighter, it's my first fight back at 150lb, 147lb in three years."I've done what I needed to do, I believe I won every round apart from the head clashes."I just want to get my world title, I want Ryan Garcia next. I want my WBC belt, keep it warm for me."He can get it next, twice on Sunday, any day of the week I'll give it you."Confusion, then deflationSky Sports’ John Dennen at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium…First confusion, then deflation. Everything seemed in place for a fight that has been at least 10 years in the making.Fury was back in boxing, after announcing his retirement at the start of last year, and Joshua has been training with the man who has conquered both, unified unbeaten heavyweight world champion Oleksandr Usyk.The all-British heavyweight mega-fight had been trailed earlier on in the night too. The announcement, it seemed, was imminent. The crowd, the press, everyone in attendance, wanted to see Fury and AJ at long last face off and say that yes, indeed this fight is on.Instead there was an awkward wait, not helped by the sound from Joshua’s microphone not playing out to the stadium.Joshua didn’t say no to Fury. But he didn’t yes immediately and he declined to step through the ropes to provide the face off we all wanted to see.The Fury-AJ mega-fight must eventually happen. But on Saturday night Anthony Joshua wasn’t going to announce it on Fury’s terms. And so the interminable wait for what should be inevitable goes on still.Garcia vs Benn next?Ryan Garcia welcomes a fight with Conor Benn next after the Brit's win over Regis Prograis. Joshua: Ball is in his courtAnthony Joshua speaking to Netflix..."I'm sorting some things out. The brotherhood are taking care of things, I have to put that first, it's my priority."Tyson Fury, if he's serious, you'll see me in the ring, I'm a serious person, the ball is in his court."I've been here a million times. At the minute there's nothing on the dotted line. There's no fight right now."Until that first bell goes there's no fight. I've been here three or four times with Wilder, Fury. This is boring to me. "I like his fighting style, I think he's good, but I don't think he'll be able to cope with me."I know it would be a lot of hard work for him."AJ: He works for meAnthony Joshua speaking to Netflix..."I'll be completely honest. There's a negotiation you go through. I've sat at this table with him many times. In my heart I fight Tyson Fury tomorrow, especially after watching that. It's not a problem with me fighting. I'm not here to get clout, I'm here to fight, contracts will be sent over and you'll probably see us in the ring more and likely. I'm not here to get in the ring and shout in somebody's face, I'm not about that. I saw what I saw and know what I've got to do when I get in the ring. "He's the one that retired, I've been in the game, never retired, I've been standing strong the last 13 years, it's on him. He disappears, comes back, I'm standing strong. I'm not here to chase fame or hype, I'll fight anybody in front of me, whether it's him or the next person."I make the big fights. He works for me."That could be a warm-up fight. I was just in a serious incident, so I need to check out what's going on with my return to the ring. "There's real stuff happening in my life, I'm not ducking anybody. There's real stuff I have to tend to. Once I'm 100 per cent I'll be ready. I run the game. Everyone knows I run the game. It's what I do, I'm very strong."When I hit Fury I'll hurt him bad."Fury reflects on winTyson Fury speaking to Netflix..."16 months out is not a short time, it's a long time. I got back to my sliding in there, I got a sharp 12 rounds. I got a good 12 valuable rounds in there. "I took out the No 5 contender in the world with ease."AJ tells Fury: You don't tell me what to doAnthony Joshua speaking on Netflix..."Tyson, you are a clout-chaser. I've never had no problem getting in a ring with you, I punched you up as kids, watching you tonight I'll punch you up again."With all due respect, tonight is your night. You won't tell me what to do. I've been chasing you the last 10 years, when you're ready you come and see me and tell me your terms and conditions. I'm the boss, you work for me. I'm the landlord. You work for me."Fury challenges AJTyson Fury speaking on Netflix..."Next, I want to give you the fight you've all been waiting for. I want you, AJ, Anthony Joshua. Let's give the fight fans what they want - the Battle of Britain. I challenge you Anthony Joshua to fight me the Gypsy King next."Do you accept my challenge?"Fury beats Makhmudov by UDTyson Fury cruises to a unanimous decision win over Arslanbek Makhmudov in his first fight since December 2024. The Gypsy King takes it 120-108, 120-108, 119-109 on the cards. AJ and Fury shake handsTyson Fury gestures towards Anthony Joshua at ringside, begging him to come into the ring as the pair shake hands.Joshua politely declines, insisting 'it's your night, it's your night'. Fury still at the highest level Former super middleweight world champion Andre Ward speaking on Netflix..."There's a lot of ways to get the job done in boxing and you're seeing Tyson Fury do it at the highest level."Some will say Makhmudov is limited, but he's strong enough and good enough."You can't take anything away from Tyson Fury offensively and defensively tonight."Fury vs Makhmudov - Round 12Fury is throwing upper-cuts at will, Makhmudov unable to swerve any of them. The Russian has offered very little in the second half of this fight, and takes another upper-cut for his troubles. The gas tank emptied a long long time ago, all power having disappeared. The crowd are excited momentarily as Fury goes on the attack; they want a stoppage. The final bell sounds, the two embrace and now the boxing world awaits the expected announcement of Tyson Fury against Anthony Joshua. Makhmudov in survival modeFormer super middleweight world champion Andre Ward speaking on Netflix..."Makhmudov is looking at the clock and hoping it can move faster."You can get knocked out or you can get boxed out. Tyson Fury is boxing out Makhmudov now."Fury vs Makhmudov - Round 11Anthony Joshua is STILL filming this fight from ringside on his phone. Fury is flicking the backhand to Makhmudov, who is giving nothing back at the moment. Makhmudov is waiting for this fight to be over now, continuously looking at the clock. Fury rocks Makhmudov with a right upper-cut, but doesn't follow up the attack. One to go. Fury seeking a big finishFormer super middleweight world champion Andre Ward speaking on Netflix..."Tyson is putting more power into his right hand. He's really looking for that knockout right now."Fury vs Makhmudov - Round 10Fury works on the inside and squeezes in an attack of body shots before Makhmudov's mouthguard comes out. Makhmudov's legs buckle momentarily another right connects, and Fury is edging ever closer to that finishing shot you feel. Fury goes on the attack at the ropes, unloading with body shots as Makhmudov takes a knee under his own exhaustion. Fury finishes the round with a left upper-cut. Impressive Fury ticking all the boxesFormer super middleweight world champion Andre Ward speaking on Netflix..."Tyson Fury is ticking all the boxes. You look at the legs and he's got spring and movement."You look at the offence and he's still landing and still sharp. "Can he take a shot? He's ticked that box. Fury still has a lot left in the tank."He's putting on a great show tonight."Fury vs Makhmudov - Round 9Fury pushes Makhmudov onto the ropes before attacking the body of the Russian. Makhmudov loses balance amid a hold before turning into a right hook from Fury. Fury finishes the round with a flurry of body shots and is closing in on a dominant win here.
